groups.capability: The link command must locate the archive under src/lib/ instead of $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a.
groups.consequence: The entry cannot link against the archive.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: archive lookup is distinct from header lookup.

groups.operation: Parse a PTR result using an IPv6 address.
groups.condition: A valid PTR packet is supplied while the entry calls the parser with a fixed IPv4 address and AF_INET.
groups.capability: The entry must supply an IPv6 address, its length, and AF_INET6.
groups.consequence: The IPv6 PTR result path cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: this concerns PTR call arguments, not A or AAAA TTL capacity.

groups.operation: Parse more than five A answers and write their TTL entries.
groups.condition: A packet contains at least six valid A answers, while the entry supplies a five-element TTL array and count 5.
groups.capability: The A parser call must provide capacity for more than five TTL entries.
groups.consequence: The sixth A TTL write cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: A and AAAA parsing are distinct target operations.

groups.operation: Parse more than five AAAA answers and write their TTL entries.
groups.condition: A packet contains at least six valid AAAA answers, while the entry supplies a five-element IPv6 TTL array and count 5.
groups.capability: The AAAA parser call must provide capacity for more than five TTL entries.
groups.consequence: The sixth AAAA TTL write cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: AAAA and A parsing are distinct target operations.

groups.condition: ares.h is located under include/ while the compile command explicitly supplies -I.
groups.capability: Resolve include/ares.h through the effective compiler header search path.
groups.consequence: The entry cannot compile if ares.h is unresolved.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same header resolution requirement. They differ only in how certain they are about the effective search path.

groups.operation: Link the entry against the libcares.la library target's archive.
groups.condition: The library target moves to src/lib while the link command names $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a.
groups.capability: Locate and link the archive produced by the src/lib library target.
groups.consequence: The target cannot link if the named archive is unavailable.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both concern the same stale root archive path. They differ in certainty about whether the old build produced libcares.a.

groups.operation: Produce a successful PTR parsing result with an IPv6 address.
groups.condition: The entry supplies a fixed four-byte address and AF_INET to its PTR call.
groups.capability: Supply a 16-byte address, its length, and AF_INET6 to PTR parsing.
groups.consequence: The entry cannot exercise a successful IPv6 PTR result.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same PTR call, IPv6 arguments, and blocked result.

groups.operation: Write TTL entries for A parsing results.
groups.condition: Six matching A results are produced while the entry supplies a five-element TTL array and count 5.
groups.capability: Provide capacity for the sixth A TTL entry.
groups.consequence: The sixth A TTL write cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the five-slot caller capacity for A TTL output; they differ in certainty about six-result reachability.

groups.operation: Write IPv6 TTL entries for AAAA parsing results.
groups.condition: Six matching AAAA results are produced while the entry supplies a five-element IPv6 TTL array and count 5.
groups.capability: Provide capacity for the sixth AAAA TTL entry.
groups.consequence: The sixth AAAA TTL write cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the five-slot caller capacity for AAAA TTL output; they differ in certainty about six-result reachability.

groups.operation: Compile the fuzz entry that includes ares.h.
groups.condition: The public header is under include/, while the compile command searches only -I.
groups.capability: Resolve include/ares.h when compiling the entry.
groups.consequence: The entry cannot compile because ares.h is not found through the supplied search path.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same header search path mismatch for the same entry compile operation.

groups.operation: Link the fuzz target with libcares.a.
groups.condition: The library target is under src/lib/, while the link command names the former root .libs/libcares.a.
groups.capability: Locate and link the archive produced by the src/lib libcares.la target.
groups.consequence: The target cannot link using the supplied archive path.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same archive location mismatch for the same link operation.

groups.operation: Parse a valid PTR reply and produce a host result carrying the caller-supplied address.
groups.condition: The PTR call fixes the address to four IPv4 bytes and the family to AF_INET.
groups.capability: Supply a 16-byte IPv6 address, its length, and AF_INET6 to the PTR parser.
groups.consequence: The call cannot exercise a PTR host result carrying the IPv6 address.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same fixed caller arguments blocking the same IPv6 PTR result.

groups.operation: Have ares_parse_a_reply write the sixth IPv4 address and TTL pair.
groups.condition: A valid reply has six matching A records, while the caller supplies capacity for five.
groups.capability: Provide more than five address and TTL output slots to ares_parse_a_reply.
groups.consequence: The sixth IPv4 address and TTL pair cannot be written through this call.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the five-slot caller capacity blocking the sixth A result.

groups.operation: Have ares_parse_aaaa_reply write the sixth IPv6 address and TTL pair.
groups.condition: A valid reply has six matching AAAA records, while the caller supplies capacity for five.
groups.capability: Provide more than five address and TTL output slots to ares_parse_aaaa_reply.
groups.consequence: The sixth IPv6 address and TTL pair cannot be written through this call.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the five-slot caller capacity blocking the sixth AAAA result.
